summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code, and nothing is committed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so metadata survives; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (plus __init__.py). Layout resolver left unchanged because Edge already defines min_size. Decisions to review: the bar position uses the displayed index rather than the full-list index so the underline lands under the displayed active tab when duplicates precede it; can_focus is set to True so keys reach the widget; letter search applies only to single-character keys; an empty label gets one flexible cell, which can misalign the row by one cell. Unverified: rich 11.2 Text.apply_meta signature and metadata preservation through Style addition in Opacity. The sandbox demo was skipped as optional.
